coverageNotes: Tests the recurring registration API with the marker supplied. A one-minute interval is a nominal schedule, not a strict completion-within-one-minute guarantee. Does not test unlimited marking batches.

questions.question: Which registration compiles and runs the mutation on a repeating one-minute interval?

options.rationale: interval accepts a schedule object with minutes, hours, or seconds. This registers a 60-second recurring mutation.
interval expects its schedule object, not a millisecond delay number.
milliseconds is not a supported interval schedule field.
cron expects a cron-expression string, not the interval schedule object.
